impact.summary: WeChat cache (~/Library/Containers/com.tencent.xinWeChat/Data/Library/Caches/*); never the message databases. The app container is protected by macOS privacy controls.
impact.regeneration: WeChat rebuilds its caches and fetches images again when they are viewed.
impact.offline_effect: Cached images and mini-program data must be downloaded again. Chat history and files (Documents/xwechat_files, Application Support) are never matched.
